---

## Comprehensive EV vs Gas Vehicle Comparison

```{r vehicle_choices}
# Create expanded vehicle choices overview with additional metrics, organized by vehicle class
ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted <- ev_vs_gas_cars %>%
  arrange(Vehicle_Class, EV_Model)

vehicle_choices <- tibble(
  Index = 1:nrow(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted),
  Vehicle_Class = ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Vehicle_Class,
  EV_Model = ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$EV_Model,
  Gas_Model = ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Gas_Model,
  EV_Efficiency = paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$EV_Efficiency, " kWh/mi"),
  Gas_Efficiency = paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Gas_Efficiency, " mpg"),
  EV_Range = paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$EV_Range, " mi"),
  Gas_Range = paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Gas_Range, " mi"),
  EV_MSRP = paste0("$", format(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$EV_MSRP, big.mark = ",")),
  Gas_MSRP = paste0("$", format(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Gas_MSRP, big.mark = ",")),
  Price_Difference = paste0("$", format(ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$EV_MSRP - ev_vs_gas_cars_sorted$Gas_MSRP, big.mark = ","))
)

# Create the enhanced table
kable(vehicle_choices, 
      caption = "Comprehensive Vehicle Comparison: Electric vs Gasoline Models",
      col.names = c("Index", "Vehicle Class", "Electric Model", "Gasoline Model", 
                   "EV Energy Use", "Gas Fuel Economy", "EV Range", "Gas Range",
                   "EV MSRP", "Gas MSRP", "Price Gap")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = TRUE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "0.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "2.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "2.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(5, width = "1.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(6, width = "1.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(7, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(8, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(9, width = "1.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(10, width = "1.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(11, width = "1.8cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Vehicle Models" = 2, "Efficiency Metrics" = 2, 
                     "Range Comparison" = 2, "MSRP Pricing" = 2, "Cost Analysis" = 1))
```

## Data Summary

```{r summary_stats}
# Add summary statistics table
summary_stats <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Total Comparisons", "Average EV MSRP", "Average Gas MSRP", 
             "Average Price Premium (EV)", "Most Efficient EV", "Most Efficient Gas Vehicle",
             "Longest Range EV", "Longest Range Gas Vehicle", "Vehicle Classes Covered"),
  Value = c(
    nrow(ev_vs_gas_cars),
    paste0("$", format(round(mean(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_MSRP)), big.mark = ",")),
    paste0("$", format(round(mean(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_MSRP)), big.mark = ",")),
    paste0("$", format(round(mean(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_MSRP - ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_MSRP)), big.mark = ",")),
    paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Model[which.min(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Efficiency)], 
           " (", min(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Efficiency), " kWh/mi)"),
    paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Model[which.max(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Efficiency)], 
           " (", max(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Efficiency), " mpg)"),
    paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Model[which.max(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Range)], 
           " (", max(ev_vs_gas_cars$EV_Range), " mi)"),
    paste0(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Model[which.max(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Range)], 
           " (", max(ev_vs_gas_cars$Gas_Range), " mi)"),
    length(unique(ev_vs_gas_cars$Vehicle_Class))
  )
)

kable(summary_stats,
      caption = "Dataset Summary Statistics",
      col.names = c("Summary Metric", "Value")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "5cm")
```
